content.text: Almost. Health Canada's guidance is to start solids around 6 months, and Theo is 5 months. Some babies show readiness a little earlier, like sitting with support, good head control, and reaching for your food. For now, milk is still his main food. A good thing to try this month is letting him sit in the high chair at family meals so he gets used to the routine. It's worth confirming timing with your provider or public health.
